summary: Alarum Technologies Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 13, 2026, disclosing litigation developments. It was served with an additional discovery motion in Tel Aviv District Court and became aware of a US class action complaint filed in New Jersey. These are ongoing legal proceedings, not a special-situation corporate event. The filing contains no deal terms, board actions, or strategic initiatives. The company intends to defend vigorously. As routine litigation disclosure, this does not qualify as a special situation under the specified categories.
